notes: Feedback catalog for the decision module (decision.py). Design and evidence: Docs/feedback-module-plan.md and §5 of the literature review (mk5). Haptic patterns are segment lists of {ms, amplitude 0-255, optional type 'transient' = a single crisp tap at the segment start}, repeated `repeat` times; the app maps them to Android VibrationEffect waveforms / iOS Core Haptics intensity. Amplitudes raised Oct 19, 2026 after the first iPhone 15 Pro Max test: 50/255 was too faint to notice, so the floor is ~100 and strong phases use 255.

breathing_pacer.description: Slow breathing at 6 breaths/min for 1 minute: gentle 4 s inhale, strong 6 s exhale (strong-exhale-phased, Miri et al. [14], [22]).

slow_heartbeat.description: Heartbeat-like 'lub-dub' at 60 bpm for 1 minute (EmotionCheck, Costa et al. [15]): two crisp taps per beat. Alternative to breathing_pacer.

descending_pulses.description: Pulses that fade from strong to faint over 10 s (graduated vibration, Jiang et al. [9]); repeated through a 2-minute pause.

soft_tap.description: Single gentle tap to accompany a non-haptic intervention.

double_tap.description: Two light taps for the recovery cue.

recovery_cue.notes: Only positive feedback: fires on a change from stressed/sad/angry to happy/neutral, never for a continuing happy/neutral state. Design choice, no direct evidence (lit review §5).
